text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to address concerns raised in the area of James Culnan School (605 Willard Avenue). It is recommended that the existing school bus loading zone located on the east side of Willard Avenue be extended an additional 30 metres to the south in order to accommodate the buses that service the school. In addition, it is recommended that the hours of the existing "Maximum 10 Minute" parking on the west side of Windermere Avenue in effect from 8:30 a.m. to 9:30 a.m. and 11:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, be amended to be in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. and 2:30 p.m. to 3:30 p.m., Monday to Friday, to coincide with the current school entry and dismissal times.
